purpose: Post-review comparison; original paper results already known. Not an independent confirmatory dataset.

main.generation: Four unchanged 120-subject blocks; block_seed=seed+1000003*block. Assert hashes against scale_stability_20261006, same ID-test samples and truths.

followup.generation: Unchanged simulator_rq1_physiological_history_value BASE. Assert full subject splits, same saved test sessions and target truths. Exclude latent targets from observable-history baselines.

methods.global_mean: Mean of train+validation outcomes; no subject history. Binary: empirical completion probability.
methods.global_median: Median of train+validation continuous outcomes, appropriate constant for MAE. Binary duplicates global_mean and is omitted.
methods.personal_mean: Mean of valid observed outcomes in the strictly previous 20 sessions of the same subject.
methods.personal_last: Most recent valid observed outcome in that window.
methods.task_mean: Mean within same task/workload (E4 u_anchor), using only the same previous window.
methods.task_last: Most recent outcome within that task/workload subset.
methods.exact_context_mean: Same task, planned demand, planned duration and gap_days for PRETASK/followup; same u_anchor, planned_minutes and gap_h for E4. Float comparison rtol=0 atol=1e-9. Mean of valid outcomes.
methods.exact_context_last: Most recent valid observed outcome in the same exact-context subset.
methods.anchor_context: No history or sensors: observed prior anchor, prescribed demand, prescribed duration, gap and task one-hot. Ridge for continuous outcomes, L2 logistic for completion. E4 log-Ridge uses prior 5km speed and evaluation_order only, equivalent input boundary to saved k0.

fallback: For all personal rules, no eligible past outcome => global_mean (all train+validation for continuous/completion, stopped-only for stopping-time target). Record fallback count. No test-based fallback selection; do not silently back off to a richer history method.
information_fairness: Past self-report mean/last is compared primarily with saved full-history k20 and C6/C7. C5 excludes self-report; self-report baselines are not same-information comparators for its score predictions. Objective recovery/completion/stop baselines are valid C5 comparators. All histories are previous observed records only; no latent values.
time_endpoint: Stopping-time MAE/RMSE/R2 on the same observed stopping cases as the stored model; completed cases have no observed stopping target. Do not substitute planned duration for event time. This comparison does not evaluate AFT censored-time C-index or establish survival-model superiority.

fitting.selection: Train-only preprocessing, validation MAE or Brier for selection; same original train+validation preprocessing/refit for final test predictions. No hyperparameter tuning outside grid.
fitting.constant: Final constants from train+validation only, consistent with original final-refit boundary.

statistics.unit: seed, never individual sessions as independent replicates
statistics.metrics: Continuous MAE/RMSE/R2; completion Brier, event rate, ROC-AUC with tied ranks and ECE10 as descriptive secondary metrics.
statistics.paired_difference: baseline error minus saved model error; positive means saved model improves upon baseline. Mean, sample SD and 95% Student-t CI across paired seeds. Relative difference uses seed-wise (baseline-model)/baseline.
statistics.multiplicity: For each dataset arm, Bonferroni simultaneous intervals across all valid baseline x target x saved-comparator primary comparisons. Also report unadjusted 95% CI; do not select a best baseline on the test set and call it prospectively selected.
statistics.decision: All planned baseline results reported, including failures and model losses. No required superiority margin; classify CI positive/negative/overlap zero descriptively, not clinical significance. Five-seed followup is exploratory.

preservation: New artifact directory only. Preserve and hash existing source/config/protocol/results. Abort on generator/data/truth mismatch; no simulator fixes or parameter changes. Save predictions, selected alphas, splits, history-source manifests, fallback counts, validation and code/protocol hashes.
